method: Plan pixels use metric scale bar, source axis registered to existing memorial frame; photograph ratios are perspective estimates, not calibrated survey.

plan_inputs.calculation: 10/76 m per pixel; rotate projected ENU into site yaw 43.5293 degrees. East end (8.94,378.79), east pier (2.78,397.53), pylon midpoint (-27.50,475.11), anchor (-40.11,516.67), west end (-41.82,521.56). Snap centreline controls to retained OSM axis, allowing roughly 2-3 m satellite parallax/edge ambiguity.
plan_inputs.deck_width_input: plan-scale.png 10 m over 113 pixels; outer deck lines perpendicular separation approximately 200-210 pixels gives 17.7-18.6 m; rail-to-rail about 16 m; carriageway about 6.4 m.

dimension_estimates.basis: Tall pylon/main-span ratio in multiple 3D orbits and primary architect photos; published secondary dimensions corroborate 56 m but no primary surveyed drawing found.
Architect southport05: eastern promenade at preserved 2.2 datum; pier visible shaft about 3 m, underside beam about .8-1 m; photograph projection uncertain.
Registered plan pixel endpoints approximately 77-83 m; primary side photo shows separate eastern support.
Architect03/04 leg width compared with approximately .18 m white cable and documented overall pylon proportions.
Architect04/06 cap and six anchor-level pixel ratios; crosshead has dark flat faces and upper maintenance railing.
Street-main people and lamp/railing ratios; pickets .14 m pitch, main posts approximately 3 m and lamps approximately 9 m.

contradictions: Provisional 28 m apex, symmetrical fan and centre position rejected. Main deck extends farther west than old OSM bridge-tag endpoint. Published width varies 18-19 m; measured reconstruction adopts 18.5 m including edge beams, 16 m between rails. No exact engineering section obtained.
